# Global Entrepreneur & Innovator Awards (GEIA)

> Official website of the Global Entrepreneur & Innovator Awards, an international award recognizing entrepreneurs, innovators, business leaders, strategic achievements, and measurable industry impact.

Canonical website: https://geiawards.com/
Languages: English and Russian

## Primary pages

- [About GEIA](https://geiawards.com/): Overview of the award and its purpose.
- [Nominations](https://geiawards.com/nominations): Award categories, eligibility, evidence requirements, and evaluation standards.
- [International jury criteria](https://geiawards.com/jurycriteria): Jury assessment principles and scoring criteria.
- [Winners](https://geiawards.com/winners): GEIA winners from 2018 through 2025 and descriptions of their achievements.
- [International jury](https://geiawards.com/jury): Members and expertise of the international jury.
- [Regulations](https://geiawards.com/regulations): Official award rules, procedures, ethics, and winner-selection process.
- [News](https://geiawards.com/news): News and insights about entrepreneurship, innovation, and international business.

## Main award categories

- Business Leadership Award
- Entrepreneur of the Year Award
- Excellence in Business Development Award
- Outstanding Industry Achievement Award
- Strategic Vision Award
- Innovation Achievement Award
